top_signals.title: Teamsters president throws down gauntlet to UPS: Strike coming in 2028
top_signals.summary:
It’s two years until the contract between United Parcel Service and its 330,000 unionized drivers and warehouse workers is due for renewal, normally a time when labor-employer relationships are less contentious.  The Teamsters union is ready for war.  In a series of self-produced Teamsters podcasts starting in mid-July, President Sean O’Brien put UPS (NYSE: UPS) […]

top_signals.title: US-Backed Tin Refiner Agrees to Buy Up to 100% of Australian Miner’s Supply
top_signals.summary: A centuries-old tin company backed by funding from the US Department of Defense agreed to buy as much as 100% of the metal concentrates produced by an Australian mining firm under a multiyear offtake agreement financed by STG Metals.
